headline: Sensex plunges over 700 points as Nifty slips below 22,400; telecom and IT stocks lead the decline

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Starlink's spectrum acquisition from Grain Management caused telecom stocks to sink up to 13%
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) reduced their holdings in 12 stocks during the September quarter
Drought in three states has flagged concerns over rising food inflation
A slide in US telecom stocks negatively impacted Indian IT shares like Tech Mahindra
whatHappening: The Sensex plunged over 700 points while the Nifty 50 index slipped below 22,400
SIP contributions reached a record monthly high of ₹32,490 crore
Swaraj Engines shares surged 15% following the announcement of its Q2 results
New India Assurance shares rose 14%, extending gains for the second consecutive session
summary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed a sharp sell-off on October 12, with the Sensex plunging over 700 points and Nifty falling below 22,400. Telecom and IT sectors were the hardest hit following global sector weakness and Starlink's spectrum deal, though SIP contributions hit a record high. Despite the downturn, Swaraj Engines and New India Assurance posted double-digit gains on positive corporate developments.
